source.title: Development, application and optimization of hydrogen refueling processes for railway vehicles
source.license: CC BY 4.0 article; raw-log reuse terms are not stated

accessed_sections.no_public_measurement_archive: PDF page 2 states that no measurement data for hydrogen-rail refuelling could be found publicly available.
accessed_sections.measured_channels: PDF pages 3-4 describe train tank pressure/temperature and HRS dispenser pressure, temperature and mass-flow measurements.
accessed_sections.station_boundary: PDF page 3 describes a transportable HRS with compressor, two storage containers and dispenser/PLC; 45/50 MPa storage was used for the 35 MPa train fill.

next_action: Request a de-identified train/HRS logger export, channel dictionary, calibration metadata and permission for derived metrics; freeze the model and scoring protocol before numerical outcomes are accessed.
claim_boundary: The article establishes that a real FCH2Rail station-to-vehicle measurement campaign exists and identifies the relevant channels, but its published figure is not a downloadable raw logger archive. It cannot close the numerical full-loop validation or SAGA effectiveness gates.
